game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when goblin raiders strike. Each round, goblin raiders strike the signal beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the b value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the signal beacon from goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs: keep the b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while b > 0.
